description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona Tech Fleece WindRunner Hoodie combines the iconic design of the WindRunner line with premium Nike Tech Fleece fabric to offer a lightweight, warm and comfortable garment. Its construction with Woven panels and football-inspired details provide a modern look perfect for everyday use or for cheering on Barça in total comfort.
key_benefits: Nike Tech Fleece fabric: Light, warm and soft both inside and out.
Adjustable Hoodie: Additional protection against wind and cold.
Woven Panels: Reinforce the WindRunner design and improve durability.
Zippered pockets: Allow you to store personal items safely.
Official FC Barcelona crest: Show your passion for the club with a premium finish.
